title: Vietnam vs Thailand: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Thailand for easier travel, better beaches, and tourist-friendly infrastructure. Vietnam for cheaper prices, more adventure, and a rawer, less touristy experience.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Both are world-class. Thai food is bolder and spicier. Vietnamese food is lighter, fresher, and cheaper.

categories.name: Beaches & Islands
categories.summary: Thailand's islands offer crystal-clear turquoise water. Vietnam's coastline has darker, rougher waters.

categories.name: Cost Comparison
categories.summary: Vietnam is 25–40% cheaper across most categories, especially accommodation and alcohol.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Thailand has better transit, more English signage, and easier logistics for tourists.

categories.name: Culture & History
categories.summary: Thailand offers serene Buddhist culture. Vietnam offers grittier war history and French colonial architecture.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Thailand's weather is simpler to plan around. Vietnam's north-south variance makes timing trickier.

categories.name: Nightlife & Entertainment
categories.summary: Thailand is a nightlife powerhouse from Full Moon parties to rooftop bars. Vietnam has charm but can't compete.

categories.name: Safety & Scams
categories.summary: Thailand feels safer day-to-day with more mature tourist infrastructure and fewer scam attempts.

categories.name: Nature & Adventure
categories.summary: Vietnam offers more raw, dramatic landscapes — from the world's largest cave to epic motorbike passes.

categories.name: Why Not Both?
categories.summary: With cheap inter-country flights ($30–80) and 3+ weeks, there's no reason to choose just one.

faq.question: Is Vietnam or Thailand better for first-time visitors to Southeast Asia?
faq.answer: Thailand is generally easier for first-timers with better tourist infrastructure, more English speakers, and simpler visa rules.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Vietnam or Thailand?
faq.answer: Vietnam is cheaper overall — 25–40% less across accommodation, food, and drinks.

faq.question: Is Vietnam or Thailand better for beaches?
faq.answer: Thailand wins for beaches with crystal-clear turquoise water at its islands.

faq.question: How long should I spend in Vietnam vs Thailand?
faq.answer: Both deserve at least 2 weeks. With 3+ weeks, you can do both countries.

faq.question: Is it easy to travel between Vietnam and Thailand?
faq.answer: Very easy — budget flights cost $30–80 one way and take 1.5–2 hours.

faq.question: Which has better food, Vietnam or Thailand?
faq.answer: No consensus — Thai food is bolder and spicier, Vietnamese is lighter and fresher. Both are world-class.

faq.question: Is Vietnam or Thailand safer for solo travelers?
faq.answer: Both are safe. Thailand has more established solo travel infrastructure. Vietnam's traffic is the main concern.

faq.question: Can I visit both Vietnam and Thailand in one trip?
faq.answer: Absolutely — with 3–4 weeks, budget flights connect them for $30–80.
